scope: original BG1 base city; nine wards, interiors and bounded underground
sourceEdition: installed BG1EE base archives; supporting evidence only

evidencePolicy.inventoryBoundary: Complete enumeration of the audited fixture is not proof that the fixture includes every original game obligation.
evidencePolicy.partial: Some adaptation mapping exists; it does not establish full interaction coverage.
evidencePolicy.planned: A source reference/quest definition exists but executable choice mapping is incomplete.
evidencePolicy.missing: No executable mapping identified; generic talk never covers source conversation branches.
evidencePolicy.excluded: Known EE/Tales addition excluded from original-base target; classic identity still needs verification.
evidencePolicy.automated: Ledger tests validate source/mapping contracts only; they award no native gameplay or parity credit.

acceptanceBlockers: The target is original BG1 base; installed EE metadata cannot establish classic behavior.
